_comment: OPTIONAL backstop. A command hook runs a shell command and does not talk to the Slack MCP server, so this posts via a Slack incoming webhook (SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL) from a small script. Use only if you want a notification to fire even when the chain is interrupted; otherwise the slack-notifier agent is sufficient. The matcher is a regex on the agent type: it matches a project agent (security-reviewer) and the plugin agent (claude-unity-devkit:security-reviewer). Add this under the top-level "hooks" key in .claude/settings.json and copy scripts/notify-slack.sh to .claude/scripts/.
